page.overview:
Who is Caitlin?

Caitlin is a -type Trainer of the Unova Elite Four, who previously served as a Lady of the Battle Castle along with the Castle's Frontier Brain, Darach.

Caitlin appears as a pale thin woman with long, wavy, blonde/light brown hair and blue-green eyes.

Caitlin's hair appears to be thigh-length and contains accessories clipped on the ends of her hair that bear the resemblance of pink butterfly wings that flutter. She wears a long-sleeved white blouse tied with a bow on the chest over a pink dress and pink shoes with white bows and soles.

Caitlin appears to have matured greatly as seen by her face with long, wavy, knee-length blonde hair that now reach her feet.
